description:
List your stored posts, server-side sorted, filtered, and offset-paginated.

Optional ``status`` filter — a single status or a comma-separated set
(e.g. ``draft,scheduled``), matched as set membership. ``sort_col`` is one of
``created|updated|status|scheduled`` (default ``created``); ``sort_dir`` is
``asc|desc``. ``search`` is a case-insensitive regular expression matched
against the post text. ``date_from``/``date_to`` accept bare ``YYYY-MM-DD``
(UTC-calendar day, end-inclusive) or an ISO instant (patron-local midnight from
the FE — exclusive upper bound when instant). Bound the ``date_field`` column,
one of ``created|updated|scheduled|sent``
(default ``created``). ``template_id`` filters to the sent occurrences a recurring
template fired. ``sent_hour`` (0–23) with ``time_zone`` (IANA) keeps only posts
whose ``last_sent_at`` local wall hour in that zone matches — used by the
Performance time-of-day chart deep-link. ``page`` is 0-indexed; ``page_size``
is 1..100. Each row carries ``is_recurring``, ``has_dynamic``, and
``template_id`` (set on sent occurrences).
Returns ``{posts:[…], total, page, page_size}`` reflecting the filtered set.

date_field.description:
The date the bounds apply to: ``created``, ``updated``,
``scheduled`` or ``sent``.

date_from.description:
Lower bound on ``date_field`` — ``YYYY-MM-DD`` or an ISO-8601
instant; blank for none.

date_to.description:
Upper bound on ``date_field`` — ``YYYY-MM-DD`` (inclusive) or an
ISO-8601 instant (exclusive); blank for none.

dpop_token.description: Proof that the caller holds npub. Either the grant envelope that receive_npub_proof returned, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235 Nostr event signed by npub: content "", a `u` tag holding this tool's exact name from tools/list, created_at within 60 s of now, and a random `nonce` tag.

npub.description: The patron's Nostr public key (npub1...). Tool fees are paid from this patron's balance; dpop_token proves the caller holds it.

search.description:
Case-insensitive regular expression matched against the post
text; blank matches all.

sent_hour.description:
Local wall-clock hour 0..23 of ``last_sent_at`` in
``time_zone``; null for no filter.

status.description:
One status or a comma-separated set of ``draft``, ``scheduled``,
``sent``, ``archived``; blank lists every status.

template_id.description:
UUID of a recurring post; keeps only the sent occurrences
it fired. Blank for no filter.

name: excalibur_list_posts
title: List posts
